The word count is an estimate and has not been measured.
summary: I cut whole optional sentences and exchanges from the first draft and estimate the result at roughly 1,100–1,115 words. The cuts are mainly the archdeacon aside, the Whittington guess, part of the kitchen exchange, dinner and doorway framing, quarrel padding, the dining-out line and Sir James's physical description. All eight protected excerpts remain verbatim. The essential beats remain: the cook's terror, Stepanov/Boris Ivanovitch, Tommy worry and the stationer's arrangement, 'Quite safe', the balcony, the Peel Edgerton quarrel, the millionaire joke, no Jane Finn, the Friday leave and the hint.
